thread.title: Apple roundup: Modem plans, Texture launch, target cut - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Apple roundup: Modem plans, Texture launch, target cut - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
The Information reports that Apple ( AAPL +0.7% ) is working on a custom cellular modem citing a job listing and an inside source.
But the source says Apple's modem could take up to three years to make its way into an iPhone.
Texture: Bloomberg reports Apple plans to launch its news and magazine subscription service Texture early next year. Apple is courting paywalled newspapers and working on a new display format for magazines that will look more like online content. Bloomberg says the efforts are getting a "chilly reception" from media execs.
Analyst action: Macquarie cuts its Apple target from $222 to $188 but maintains an Outperform rating. Analyst Benjamin Schachter expects Services growth rate to decelerate in FY19 with slowdown in App Store, Licensing, and Apple Care.
